notes.title: Playtest #3
notes.content:
[h2]Visual improvements:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Lighting has been completely redesigned:[/b] The Duat is now plunged deeper into darkness. Certain elements emphasize light emissions and glow effects, while enemies are more visually distinct.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced post-processing:[/b] Seth moves further away from Unreal Engine's default rendering, with more stylized shadows, refined cel-shading, and an overall more artistic visual style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully simulated enemy fabrics:[/b] Enemy clothing is now always physically simulated, adding greater realism to their movements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved physical reactions:[/b] Enemies now react more realistically to shots, with responses based on the impact’s location and force.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced enemy projectiles:[/b] Visual and physical feedback of enemy projectiles has been improved for greater impact and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental gilding:[/b] Gold elements in the environment now shine and reflect light more realistically.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay improvements: [/h2][list][*][p][b]Aim assist has been completely redesigned[/b] for gamepad users.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad vibrations are now partially procedural[/b], providing much more immersive feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]The activation button has been merged with the melee button.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowing down the arc further reduces camera rotation speed, helping players aim more precisely.[/p][/*][*][p]When a teleportation portal is taken backwards, the player now exits in the correct direction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hit markers and damage text are now localized[/b], offering clearer and more responsive feedback.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Game design changes:[/h2][list][*][p]The entry corridor now follows the same rules as other arenas: combat first, then reward. However, the reward is always a power.[/p][p][i]We look forward to your feedback![/i][/p][/*][/list][h2]Codex:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Learn more about enemies, gods, locations, and weapons[/b] by slaughtering your enemies and gaining more powers.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Rankings and victory screen:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rankings are now also separated by weapon.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The victory screen has been completely redesigned[/b] and now displays your best score and number of attempts for each weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A new option allows you to play without weapons[/b]. Looking for a greater challenge? Try to reach the leaderboard in the [b]Brutal[/b] category.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards have been fully reset.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing:[/h2][list][*][p][b]The spells have been rebalanced based on your feedback[/b]. We are still listening to your comments so we can continue to improve the balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels have had their waves slightly modified. Your input on this remains valuable.[/p][/*][*][p]Burns now last 4 seconds and deal increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy projectiles are now slightly slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Akh now pause longer after teleporting and before attacking again.[/p][/*][*][p]Embalmer and akh now visibly holds their projectiles at the end of their staffs and in their hands, respectively, before throwing them, giving players clearer warning.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Optimization:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Textures are now streamed[/b] rather than preloaded order to reduce VRAM requirements. This makes Seth compatible with GPUs with low VRAM. Textures load dynamically based on your GPU's capabilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall level art has been optimized to reduce GPU load.[/p][/*][*][p]A pooling system has been added for all player and enemy projectiles to reduce CPU-related FPS drops.[/p][/*][*][p]The framerate of enemy animations has been reduced based on their visibility to optimize CPU performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]
As always, your feedback remains essential to improve the game. Thank you very much for your continued support. [b]We can't wait to hear yours feedbacks![/b][/p]

notes.title: Playtest #2 - Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[h1]Improvments:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spells now hit precisely where they are intended
[*] Fluid simulation system replaced by a more stable and less performance-intensive one
[*] Power selection screen slightly revised
[*] Objective text enlarged
[/list]
[h1]Balancing: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Embalmers' shots are slowed by 25%
[*] Enemy waves have been slightly modified
[/list]
[h1]Crash fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] In some cases by returning to the hub 
[*] In some case using Ra's dash power
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] When melee from the air, the behavior is very strange
[*] It is possible to reroll powers more than once per run
[*] Enemies are sometimes blocked when trying to descend to the lower level
[*] When standing on a reward altar, melee enemies do not attack
[*] In the power selection menu between two powers, the selection is unstable
[*] After rerolling a power, if a replaced power was legendary, the animation continues to play
[*] The reward altar room remains in the down position after reloading a game where the reward has already been taken
[*] The player's landing system loops standing on not walkable surfaces
[*] The visual effect of destructible floors is buggy
[*] Invisible walls are present in the hub
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest #2 - Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Improvments:[/h1]
[list]
[*] CPU performance optimized
[*] A confirmation system has been added for refusing to choose a power
[*] The melee target selection system has been revised
[*] Melee power refunded if no enemy hit
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Upgrade to reroll powers doesn't work
[*] Grenade count incorrectly updated with the upgrade to increase it
[*] Visual bug when the bow is selected in the hub
[*] Crash sometimes with Ra's dash power
[*] Herald of Apophis mesh can sometimes be penetrated
[*] Enemies appear out of bounds in a map
[*] You can stand behind teleportation portals
[*] Twitch integration displays uninitialized defaults
[*] Twitch integration updates incorrectly when a choice is not selected by anyone
[*] Twitch integration doesn't display elements in the right order
[*] It's possible to launch the hover animation of the power selection screen before the power appearance animation has finished.
[*] Picking up a jumppad twice in succession without touching the ground alters the player's movements.
[*] The player can launch himself into the air by striking an enemy above him.
[*] Merchant rooms have no description on the door
[*] Merchant rooms have in Twitch integration
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest #2 - Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Thanks to you, we've discovered a number of particularly annoying bugs in the second playtest. Here's the first hotfix to fix them as soon as possible!
Also, to apologize for any inconvenience caused, we're offering 500 hekas for each save made in 0.2.0.0 : you have nothing to do, just reload youre save. The tutorial, will appear again, just skip it.

Major bug fixes:
- Weapons no longer appear in the hub when loading a savegame
- Melee bugs and completely blocks the player's movements, requiring the game to be restarted (this happens more often with the grappling hook or when framerate drops)
 - Performance is weaker in some combat rooms

Other fixes:
- Timer starts if the training character is killed
- Fire weapon disappears after melee in some cases until next melee hit
- Some out of bounds in the levels
- Localization errors
